summary: This unit covers the rural Lolo and Yamongili secteurs and the rural part of Bumba secteur in Bumba territory, Mongala province, including the Lolo centre (Mongbandi/Likwangola), the Yamongili area and the Siforco logging concession around Mohonge. Mongala is far from the eastern and Mai-Ndombe/Kwilu conflict zones, and no armed group is known to hold territory here. Order is kept by the Congolese National Police (PNC) through posts at secteur and groupement centres, alongside secteur and customary authorities. The main security issues are banditry, local land and customary disputes and tensions around logging concessions, none of which amounts to armed-group control. No web research was possible in this run because the search budget was exhausted, so the assessment rests on default state presence.

zones.description: Larger settlements (5,000+ inhabitants): Lolo secteur centre (Mongbandi, Likwangola/Mission Lolo, Bokata, Yesele, Yamautu, Yandombo, Yamkolo), the Siforco/Mohonge logging camps, Yaelimo, Yalihila, Lihulu, Yzhangani, Yanzeka
zones.evidence: Secteur centres and large villages in a part of Mongala with no reported armed-group activity. PNC posts and the secteur administration handle arrests and order. No sources could be retrieved in this run.

zones.description: Smaller rural villages of the Lolo, Yamongili and Bumba secteurs (Lolo, Yamongili and Bumba health zones)
zones.evidence: A rural area with no reported armed-group activity. State authority is exercised through PNC posts and secteur and customary chiefs. Policing is thin, but no non-state armed actor is known to hold the monopoly of force. No sources could be retrieved in this run.
